Game Overview

In Construction Simulator, the core idea is straightforward: immerse yourself in a realistic construction world where driving precision meets creative building challenges. Master a variety of massive vehicles, from cement mixers to cranes, and tackle intricate missions that test your skills. Every task, from steel transport to skyscraper assembly, pushes your construction prowess to the limits.
